items.definition: To make something harmful, unpleasant, or bad less severe or serious.
items.exampleSentence: Coastal wetlands help mitigate the destructive impact of tropical storms.
items.exampleTranslationId: Lahan basah pesisir membantu mengurangi dampak merusak badai tropis.

quiz.prompt: Urban planners planted thousands of trees to ______ the heat-island effect in the city center.
quiz.explanationId: 'Mitigate' berarti mengurangi atau meringankan dampak negatif (seperti efek pulau panas).

items.definition: Seeming to be present or found everywhere at the same time.
items.exampleSentence: Contactless payment terminals have become ubiquitous in metropolitan transit systems.
items.exampleTranslationId: Terminal pembayaran nirsentuh telah ada di mana-mana dalam sistem transportasi metropolitan.

quiz.prompt: In TOEFL Reading, the word 'ubiquitous' is closest in meaning to:
quiz.explanationId: 'Ubiquitous' bersinonim dengan 'omnipresent' atau 'found everywhere'.

items.meaningId: menguatkan, membuktikan kebenaran dengan bukti tambahan
items.definition: To confirm or give support to a statement, theory, or finding with evidence.
items.exampleSentence: Ice-core samples from Antarctica corroborate earlier temperature models.
items.exampleTranslationId: Sampel inti es dari Antartika menguatkan model suhu sebelumnya.

quiz.prompt: Archaeologists discovered inscriptions that ______ the historian's account of the trade route.
quiz.explanationId: 'Corroborate' berarti mendukung atau mengonfirmasi klaim/teori dengan bukti nyata.

items.definition: Based on observation or experience rather than pure theory or logic.
items.exampleSentence: The policy proposal lacked sufficient empirical evidence to persuade lawmakers.
items.exampleTranslationId: Usulan kebijakan tersebut kekurangan bukti empiris yang cukup untuk meyakinkan legislator.

quiz.prompt: Scientific conclusions must rest on ______ observation rather than personal intuition.
quiz.explanationId: 'Empirical' merujuk pada data yang diperoleh melalui eksperimen atau pengamatan langsung.

items.definition: An illogical or surprising lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts.
items.exampleSentence: Auditors immediately flagged a discrepancy between the shipping manifest and the invoice.
items.exampleTranslationId: Auditor segera menandai ketidaksesuaian antara manifes pengiriman dan faktur.

quiz.prompt: The finance team investigated the ______ between projected expenses and actual quarterly costs.
quiz.explanationId: 'Discrepancy' berarti selisih atau ketidaksesuaian antara dua angka atau laporan.

items.definition: Possible and practical to do easily or conveniently.
items.exampleSentence: Expanding the rail line proved economically feasible once ridership projections increased.
items.exampleTranslationId: Perluasan jalur kereta terbukti layak secara ekonomi setelah proyeksi penumpang meningkat.

quiz.prompt: Before approving the factory relocation, management commissioned a study to determine whether the plan was ______.
quiz.explanationId: 'Feasible' berarti dapat direalisasikan secara praktis maupun finansial.

items.definition: To make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse.
items.exampleSentence: Prolonged drought can exacerbate food insecurity across arid regions.
items.exampleTranslationId: Kekeringan berkepanjangan dapat memperparah kerawanan pangan di wilayah kering.

quiz.prompt: Removing green spaces without improving drainage will ______ seasonal flooding.
quiz.explanationId: 'Exacerbate' adalah kebalikan dari 'alleviate/mitigate'; artinya memperparah kondisi.

items.definition: Never having happened or existed in the past.
items.exampleSentence: Renewable energy investment reached an unprecedented level last year.
items.exampleTranslationId: Investasi energi terbarukan mencapai tingkat yang belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya tahun lalu.

quiz.prompt: The museum attracted an ______ number of visitors during its digital exhibition.
quiz.explanationId: 'Unprecedented' berarti tidak ada presedennya atau belum pernah terjadi sebelumnya.

items.definition: Seeming reasonable, probable, or believable.
items.exampleSentence: Volcanic activity offers a plausible explanation for the sudden drop in global temperatures.
items.exampleTranslationId: Aktivitas vulkanik menawarkan penjelasan yang masuk akal atas penurunan suhu global yang mendadak.

quiz.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to 'plausible'?
quiz.explanationId: 'Plausible' berarti masuk akal atau 'credible' (dapat dipercaya).

items.definition: Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning.
items.exampleSentence: The contract was revised to eliminate ambiguous wording regarding overtime pay.
items.exampleTranslationId: Kontrak tersebut direvisi untuk menghilangkan redaksi yang ambigu terkait upah lembur.

quiz.prompt: Because the survey question was ______, respondents interpreted it in two completely different ways.
quiz.explanationId: 'Ambiguous' berarti bermakna ganda sehingga memicu penafsiran berbeda.

items.definition: To provide evidence to prove the truth of a claim.
items.exampleSentence: Applicants must submit official transcripts to substantiate their academic credentials.
items.exampleTranslationId: Pelamar harus melampirkan transkrip resmi untuk membuktikan kredensial akademik mereka.

quiz.prompt: In IELTS Writing Task 2, strong essays always ______ their main claims with clear examples.
quiz.explanationId: 'Substantiate' berarti mendukung argumen dengan bukti nyata.

items.definition: Able to withstand or recover quickly from difficult conditions.
items.exampleSentence: Diversified suppliers make the company's logistics network more resilient to disruptions.
items.exampleTranslationId: Pemasok yang terdiversifikasi membuat jaringan logistik perusahaan lebih tangguh terhadap gangguan.

quiz.prompt: Coral species that survive warmer ocean temperatures are considered more ______.
quiz.explanationId: 'Resilient' berarti tangguh dan mampu bertahan/pulih dari tekanan lingkungan.

items.meaningId: berkembang biak atau bertambah banyak dengan cepat
items.definition: To increase rapidly in numbers; to multiply.
items.exampleSentence: Online micro-learning platforms have proliferated over the past five years.
items.exampleTranslationId: Platform pembelajaran mikro daring telah berkembang pesat selama lima tahun terakhir.

quiz.prompt: Without natural predators, invasive algae can ______ across an entire lake within weeks.
quiz.explanationId: 'Proliferate' berarti bertambah banyak atau menyebar dengan sangat cepat.

items.definition: Logical, consistent, and clearly connected as a unified whole.
items.exampleSentence: Transition phrases help readers follow a coherent line of reasoning.
items.exampleTranslationId: Frasa transisi membantu pembaca mengikuti alur penalaran yang runtut.

quiz.prompt: Examiners look for a ______ essay structure where every paragraph supports the central thesis.
quiz.explanationId: 'Coherent' berarti terhubung secara logis dan mudah diikuti.

items.definition: Tending to cause harm or damage.
items.exampleSentence: Chronic sleep deprivation is detrimental to both memory retention and concentration.
items.exampleTranslationId: Kurang tidur kronis merugikan daya ingat sekaligus konsentrasi.

quiz.prompt: Excessive noise pollution can have a ______ effect on marine mammals' navigation.
quiz.explanationId: 'Detrimental' berarti merugikan atau berbahaya (sering diikuti preposisi 'to').

items.definition: To pay back money to someone who has spent it on behalf of an organization.
items.exampleSentence: The company will reimburse employees for approved hotel and meal receipts.
items.exampleTranslationId: Perusahaan akan mengganti biaya hotel dan makan karyawan yang telah disetujui.

quiz.prompt: Please submit your boarding pass so accounting can ______ your airfare next Friday.
quiz.explanationId: 'Reimburse' adalah kata kunci TOEIC yang berarti mengganti biaya pengeluaran dinas.

items.definition: A planned route or detailed schedule of a journey.
items.exampleSentence: The executive assistant emailed the revised Tokyo conference itinerary to all delegates.
items.exampleTranslationId: Asisten eksekutif mengirim revisi jadwal perjalanan konferensi Tokyo kepada seluruh delegasi.

quiz.prompt: Check the updated ______ to confirm your hotel check-in time and shuttle departure.
quiz.explanationId: 'Itinerary' merujuk pada jadwal rinci perjalanan dinas atau wisata.

items.definition: Given or supplied free of charge as a courtesy.
items.exampleSentence: All registered conference attendees receive a complimentary shuttle pass from the airport.
items.exampleTranslationId: Seluruh peserta konferensi yang terdaftar menerima tiket antar-jemput gratis dari bandara.

quiz.prompt: Hotel guests staying more than three nights are entitled to ______ access to the business lounge.
quiz.explanationId: Bedakan 'complimentary' (gratis/memuji) dengan 'complementary' (saling melengkapi).

items.definition: The process of obtaining supplies, equipment, or services for business operations.
items.exampleSentence: The procurement department negotiated a 12 percent bulk discount with the paper supplier.
items.exampleTranslationId: Departemen pengadaan menegosiasikan diskon grosir 12 persen dengan pemasok kertas.

quiz.prompt: All vendor bids above $10,000 must be reviewed by the ______ committee.
quiz.explanationId: 'Procurement' adalah istilah korporasi untuk proses pengadaan barang/jasa dari vendor.

items.meaningId: sementara, belum final dan masih bisa berubah
items.definition: Not certain or fixed; provisional and subject to change.
items.exampleSentence: We have set a tentative launch date of October 15 pending final software testing.
items.exampleTranslationId: Kami menetapkan tanggal peluncuran sementara 15 Oktober sambil menunggu uji perangkat lunak akhir.

quiz.prompt: The agenda attached below is still ______, so please suggest any topics before Tuesday.
quiz.explanationId: 'Tentative' berarti masih bersifat sementara dan belum dikunci final.

items.definition: To make an organization or system more efficient by simplifying processes.
items.exampleSentence: Automating invoice verification will streamline our monthly closing workflow.
items.exampleTranslationId: Otomatisasi verifikasi faktur akan menyederhanakan alur penutupan bulanan kami.

quiz.prompt: The new digital portal was introduced to ______ customer onboarding and cut waiting times in half.
quiz.explanationId: 'Streamline' sering muncul di TOEIC untuk menyatakan peningkatan efisiensi proses kerja.

items.definition: Required by law, policy, or official rules; compulsory.
items.exampleSentence: Annual cybersecurity awareness training is mandatory for all full-time staff.
items.exampleTranslationId: Pelatihan kesadaran keamanan siber tahunan bersifat wajib bagi seluruh staf penuh waktu.

quiz.prompt: Wearing safety goggles inside the laboratory is strictly ______.
quiz.explanationId: 'Mandatory' bersinonim dengan 'compulsory' atau 'obligatory' (wajib).

items.definition: Producing a great deal of profit.
items.exampleSentence: Securing the regional distribution deal proved highly lucrative for the manufacturer.
items.exampleTranslationId: Mendapatkan kesepakatan distribusi regional terbukti sangat menguntungkan bagi produsen tersebut.

quiz.prompt: The consulting firm signed a ______ three-year contract with an international airline.
quiz.explanationId: 'Lucrative' berarti menghasilkan keuntungan finansial yang besar.

items.definition: To make an action or process happen sooner or be accomplished more quickly.
items.exampleSentence: Submitting complete documentation upfront will expedite your visa application.
items.exampleTranslationId: Menyerahkan dokumen lengkap sejak awal akan mempercepat pengajuan visa Anda.

quiz.prompt: Because the client's deadline moved up, the warehouse agreed to ______ the shipment.
quiz.explanationId: 'Expedite' berarti mempercepat proses (kebalikan dari 'impede/delay').

items.definition: General agreement among a group of people.
items.exampleSentence: After two hours of debate, the board finally reached a consensus on the annual budget.
items.exampleTranslationId: Setelah dua jam berdiskusi, dewan akhirnya mencapai kesepakatan bersama mengenai anggaran tahunan.

quiz.prompt: There is a broad scientific ______ that early intervention improves literacy outcomes.
quiz.explanationId: 'Consensus' berarti persetujuan umum di antara para ahli atau anggota rapat.

items.definition: To distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose.
items.exampleSentence: The municipality decided to allocate additional funds to public library renovations.
items.exampleTranslationId: Pemerintah kota memutuskan untuk mengalokasikan dana tambahan guna renovasi perpustakaan umum.

quiz.prompt: Managers must carefully ______ staff hours to meet peak holiday demand.
quiz.explanationId: 'Allocate' berarti membagi atau menetapkan dana/waktu untuk tujuan tertentu.

items.definition: To rise and fall irregularly in number or amount.
items.exampleSentence: Coffee export prices continued to fluctuate between $2.10 and $2.85 per kilogram.
items.exampleTranslationId: Harga ekspor kopi terus berfluktuasi antara $2,10 hingga $2,85 per kilogram.

quiz.prompt: In IELTS Writing Task 1, which verb best describes a graph line that repeatedly goes up and down?
quiz.explanationId: 'Fluctuate' khusus menggambarkan tren data yang naik-turun berulang kali.

items.meaningId: memeriksa secara sangat teliti dan kritis
items.definition: To examine or inspect closely and thoroughly.
items.exampleSentence: Peer reviewers scrutinize every statistical assumption before accepting a manuscript.
items.exampleTranslationId: Penelaah sejawat memeriksa setiap asumsi statistik secara teliti sebelum menerima naskah.

quiz.prompt: Regulators will ______ the merger agreement to ensure fair market competition.
quiz.explanationId: 'Scrutinize' berarti memeriksa dengan cermat dan mendalam.

items.definition: Making a certain situation or outcome likely or possible.
items.exampleSentence: Quiet, well-lit study rooms create an atmosphere conducive to deep concentration.
items.exampleTranslationId: Ruang belajar yang tenang dan terang menciptakan suasana yang kondusif untuk konsentrasi mendalam.

quiz.prompt: High humidity and warm soil are especially ______ to the growth of tropical ferns.
quiz.explanationId: 'Conducive to' berarti mendukung atau memudahkan suatu hasil terjadi.

items.definition: A future event or circumstance that is possible but cannot be predicted with certainty; a backup provision.
items.exampleSentence: Event organizers drafted a contingency plan in case heavy rain forces the ceremony indoors.
items.exampleTranslationId: Penyelenggara acara menyusun rencana cadangan jika hujan deras memaksa upacara dipindah ke dalam ruangan.

quiz.prompt: Every responsible project budget sets aside a 10% ______ fund for unexpected repairs.
quiz.explanationId: 'Contingency fund/plan' berarti dana atau rencana darurat untuk mengantisipasi kejadian tak terduga.
